name: Alberta

plates.name: Alberta Conservation Plate
plates.fact: The design shows Mount Lougheed and Rocky Mountain bighorn sheep, Alberta's official provincial mammal.

plates.name: Edmonton Oilers Licence Plate
plates.fact: Proceeds help fund health, wellness, education and minor hockey programs for youth in northern Alberta.

plates.name: Calgary Flames Licence Plate
plates.fact: The plate features the Flames' colours, logo and slogan.

plates.name: Support our Troops Licence Plate
plates.supports: Support our Troops program (Canadian Forces Morale and Welfare Services)
plates.fact: Its artwork honours the first four Alberta-based Canadian soldiers killed in Afghanistan in April 2002, and anyone can order it.

plates.name: Veterans licence plate
plates.fact: Applicants must be approved by the Royal Canadian Legion, Alberta/NWT Command.

plates.name: Amateur Radio Operator (HAM) licence plate
plates.fact: Available to Albertans who hold an Amateur Radio Operator Certificate.

about: Alberta special-design plates, from the province's own list on 2026-10-26. Not rated yet: every plate is worth the same.
